paragraphs: Rav Idi bar Shimi: Chullin 26a as cited by Hyman.[^4] Rabbah bar Shimi: [Pesachim 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.6b.5).

notes.text: כו./ו:/כז: give Chullin 26a/Pesachim 6b/Keritot 27b by convention, without fresh edition checks. Earlier machine כג and damaged ו marker differ from the supplied text.

Rav Shimi bar Abba has no supplied citation; none is invented. This heading groups four attestations, not a single identified father. Full רב remains Rav for Idi, Shmuel and Shimi; רבה is the name Rabbah, without a separate title added.

The linked Pesachim has Rabbah bar Shimi report Ravina. In Keritot, Rav Shmuel bar Shimi interprets a teaching before Rav Papa. Compare [Heilprin’s Shimi bar Abba notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3303&lang=en), which questions a report of two men named Shimi bar Abba.

[Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 578:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.578.8) names Rav Idi bar Shimi as the speaker in the story of the whistling bird. The parallel at [Chullin 63a:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.63a.11) reads Rav Adda bar Shimi. Hyman’s supplied Chullin 26a remains unconfirmed.
